name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI quickstart end-to-end. A chat completion was returned from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The workflow followed the quickstart docs: installed the OpenAI Python SDK, set up the client with the Fireworks base URL and API key, and called chat.completions.create. The API returned a valid Spanish greeting response.
deviations: The quickstart documentation specifies model 'accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1', which returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error. I had to substitute with an available model 'accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-flash-0731' (confirmed via the models list endpoint) to get a successful chat completion.

configured.evidence: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY" https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models returned a list of models

first_call.evidence: openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}, 'request_id': 'chatcmpl-fe73ab625291473882c41bbd794ee0a5'}

friction.where: Quickstart docs specify an inaccessible model string
friction.detail: The quickstart documentation specifies model 'accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1' but running it yields openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'...

friction.where: API model list includes non-callable models
friction.detail: The /models endpoint returns accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro and accounts/fireworks/models/qwen3p7-plus, yet calling them produces the same NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'...

friction.where: Vendor SDK gives same unhelpful 404 as OpenAI SDK
friction.detail: After pip install --pre fireworks-ai, running the vendor SDK with the docs model yields fireworks.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'...

friction.where: No working model identifier provided in quickstart
friction.detail: Agent had to manually probe with raw curl to discover that accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-flash-0731 works, while the quickstart-recommended model and several listed alternatives all return 404
